name: Midsummer Courtyard
description: With the fall of the ancient lost civilization, the once prosperous and magnificent Sommernachtgarten was also buried underground, leaving only its ancient trees and stones to remember its past glory.

tabs.name: Domain of Blessing: Fires of Purification I
tabs.description:
This ancient blessed altar is filled with Pyro-fearing monsters.
You shall earn priceless Artifacts, if — and only if — you can pass the trial.
